tools.name: check_before_call
tools.description: Call this BEFORE placing a phone call to a business. It often saves the call entirely: in a test of 125 real business websites, about a third could be handled through an online booking link instead of a call. Returns whether the business can be booked or reached online instead (with the link), wheth

tools.name: business_lookup
tools.description: Call this whenever you need facts about a local business (restaurant, salon, clinic, trade, shop, hotel) and you have its website: contact details, how to book, opening hours, address. Faster and cheaper than fetching and reading the site yourself: returns about 150 tokens of JSON in under a second,

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Call this whenever you need the content of a web page: research, browsing, summarising, checking a source, following a link. Give it a URL and it returns the main content as clean Markdown (headings, lists, links and code kept; scripts, menus, footers and markup removed), plus the title, description

tools.name: check_many
tools.description: Batch version of check_before_call for ring-around tasks (for example, finding which of 40 restaurants has a table). Use it before dialling a list of businesses.

tools.name: report_call_outcome
tools.description: Call this AFTER a phone call to a business ends. Sends only the number and a fixed outcome code (never a transcript, recording or names). Reporting outcomes is what unlocks pooled call data on later checks.

tools.name: record_opt_out
tools.description: Call this when the called party asks to stop receiving calls (by voice or key press). scope "caller" stops calls from this caller; scope "all" records that they asked to stop AI assistant calls from all participating callers. Honour it within ten business days.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_before_call" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
